notes.title: Intro "tutorial" update
notes.content:
[b][h1]Minor but helpful intro "tutorial" update[/h1][/b]

[h2]People have asked for a little guidance in the beginning of this massive open world RPG Adventure and your prayers have been heard.

Added some short help texts for the beginning of the game.
Hope it helps some of you to get past the first part.
[/h2]
[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1829940/extras/Firstpageimage.png?t=1643229597][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1829940/extras/Firstpageimage.png?t=1643229597[/img][/url]

[h3]Have fun out there![/h3]
(Sometimes a fled battle is a won battle in the end)

notes.title: Release Party - Downfall of Krynto
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello![/b][/h1]

[h3]To celebrate the Release of the game: '[b]Downfall of Krynto[/b]', Sloppy Joe Studios will hand out a [b]free game[/b] for every sold '[b]Downfall of Krynto[/b]'-Game on Steam.[/h3]

[h3]When buying [b]Downfall of Krynto[/b], send the receipt to [b]info@sloppyjoestudios.com[/b] to get access to the other title: '[b]Lotharus - Bacon, Ale & Repeat[/b]' for free!
Welcome to the party [b]2022 January 27th[/b][/h3] 💾🌕

[h1][b]Downfall of Krynto[/b][/h1]
[h3]A Retro-Styled RPG with Turn-Based Battles, lots of exploration and puzzle-solving. Mixed with a Dark Story about a Land very close to its Downfall!
You can team up to be four friends taking on the Evil Darkness in Local co-op play anywhere!
[PC][/h3]
